definitions: To risk everything on a single venture or opportunity.
To concentrate all of one's resources or efforts into one area, making oneself vulnerable if that area fails.
examples: Don't put all your eggs in one basket when investing.
She decided not to put all her eggs in one basket and applied to several universities.
It's unwise to put all your eggs in one basket with a new business.
lemma: to put all one's eggs in one basket
synonyms: to stake everything on one throw
to risk it all on one thing
source: to put all one's eggs in one basket
